name: ai4u-documentation-assistance
description: Agent skills that produce delivery documentation for SAP AI applications and PoCs: technical handover handbooks and AI4U use-case one-pager images.

interface.shortDescription: Delivery documentation and one-pager skills for SAP AI projects.
interface.longDescription: Generates SAP-styled technical handover Word handbooks for application and PoC codebases (usage, architecture diagrams, API catalog, AI capabilities, path to production) and AI4U use-case one-pager images (personas, app screenshot, challenge, solution, benefits) in the standard AI4U template.
defaultPrompt: Create a technical handover document for this repository.
Document this PoC so an implementation team can take it over.
Create a one-pager image for this use case.
